en: A black-and-white image depicting a large, old stone building with multiple windows and a tiled roof, situated on a slight hill or raised area. In the foreground, there are additional stone buildings and lush trees. The background shows faint hills or mountains. The architectural style and cypress trees suggest a Mediterranean, likely Southern European, setting. There is no visible text on the front of the postcard.
